sentences.text:
REKHA PALLI  ORDER  % 19.04.2023  CM APPL. 18894/2023 -Ex.
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
3.
The present appeal preferred by the insurer under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 seeks to assail the award dated 17.01.2023 passed by the learned MACT.

4. Even though the appeal is premised on two grounds, the first being non grant of recovery rights to the appellant against the driver and owner of the offending vehicle and the second being grant of interest @ 7% p.a., on the compensation awarded to the claimants under the impugned award.
After some arguments, learned counsel for the appellant submits that does not press the ground regarding the rate of interest.
5. Issue notice confined to the aspect of non grant of recovery rights to the appellant against the driver and owner of the offending vehicle.

9. List on 13.10.2023.
CM APPL. 18893/2023 -Stay.
10.This is an application preferred by the appellant seeking stay of the impugned award.

Taking into account that the present appeal is confined only to the question of non grant of recovery rights claimed by the appellant against respondent nos. 6 & 7, no ground is made out for staying the impugned award.

12.It is, however, made clear that payment of any amount by the appellant to the claimants would remain subject to outcome of the present appeal and therefore, in case the appellant succeeds before this Court, they would be entitled to recover the amount from respondent nos. 6 & 7.
